jei.info.prospecting_pickaxe: Can be used to help locate hidden ores. Can have gems slotted into it at the Smithing Table to enhance its capabilities. Slotted gems can be removed by clicking on a Grindstone.
jei.info.gem_quartz: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, locks its search to a single ore type. Sneak+click an ore to set the lock, sneak+click anything else to clear it.
jei.info.gem_diamond: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, prioritizes rarer ores over the nearest one when multiple are in range.
jei.info.gem_emerald: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, reveals how many connected ore blocks are in the same vein.
jei.info.gem_lapis: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, spends 5 experience levels to reveal exact directions to the ore. No XP is spent if nothing is found.
jei.info.gem_amethyst: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, makes the ore ping audible through walls.
jei.info.gem_topaz: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, makes the ore glow with a shimmering light, visible through walls.
jei.info.gem_ruby: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, shows the exact distance from you to the ore, instead of a vague hint.
jei.info.gem_sapphire: When socketed into a Prospecting Pickaxe, increases the search radius by 8 blocks.
jei.info.zipline: Use one on a fence post, then on a second fence post to string a zipline between them. Right-click the line with an empty hand, a Grappling Hook or an unloaded Crossbow to grab on. Gentle slopes can be ridden either way, steep ones only downhill. Sneak to let go, jump to hop off, and hit the line to take it down.
jei.info.minecart_link: Use a chain on a minecart, then on another minecart nearby to couple them so they roll as one train. Each minecart can be coupled at both ends. Use Shears on a coupled minecart to undo its couplings, and breaking a minecart drops its chains. Couplings snap if the minecarts are dragged too far apart.
jei.info.grappling_hook: Throw it by hand, or load it into a Crossbow to fire it further. Once it catches, hold %s to reel in and %s to let out slack, and move to swing. Use it again to retract. While it is hooked to a block, use it on a fence post to turn the line into a zipline. It can also hook mobs and drag them toward you, or snag dropped items and reel them in.
jei.info.slime_bucket: Use an empty Bucket on a small Slime to catch it. The slime gets excited inside a slime chunk, so you can use it to find one. Slimes can't be released on Peaceful.
jei.info.dynamite: Light it with Flint and Steel or a Fire Charge in your other hand, or by using it on a fire, torch, candle, campfire or lit furnace. Hold use to wind up a throw, but don't hold on too long. Use it on the ground to place it, or sneak to place it while holding something to light it with. Water puts the fuse out.
jei.info.pan: Use a pan on a sparkle node to sift it for loot. Sparkle nodes form in water over sand, dirt and gravel, and in lava over Nether ground, which only the Netherite Pan can sift. Panning Luck adds an extra roll per level.
jei.info.rock_candy: Eating it grants Haste and Glimmer. Glimmer makes nearby ores glint through walls, like a Prospecting Pickaxe socketed with Topaz.
jei.info.altimeter: Hold it in either hand to see your current elevation.
jei.info.mining_helmet: Wear it to light the way underground. Press %s to switch the lamp on or off. It protects like an Iron Helmet and wears down as you take hits, and the lamp can grow dimmer and start to flicker as it gets damaged. Repair it with Iron Ingots. It can be dyed like leather armor, and a water cauldron washes the dye off.
jei.info.extinguished_light: Torches and Lanterns can go out. Torches left out in the rain may sputter out, a splash Water Bottle douses any torches and lanterns it hits, and torches or lanterns dropped into water go out too. Light them again with Flint and Steel, a Fire Charge or a lit Torch, which isn't used up.
jei.info.wooden_rail: A cheap, rickety rail. Minecarts can't go as fast on it and slowly lose speed, and riders get rattled around along the way. It can catch fire.
jei.info.launch_rail: A straight rail that throws minecarts into the air while powered by redstone. Carts rolling over it jump forward, and powering it while a cart sits on top launches it from a standstill.
jei.info.payload_rail: A straight rail that only reacts to loaded minecarts. It gives off a redstone signal while a cart with a rider or cargo is on it, and ignores empty carts. A Comparator reads what is aboard: 15 for a player, 12 for a villager, 9 for an animal, 6 for a baby, 3 for a hostile mob and 1 for anything else. Storage carts read how full they are, and TNT carts always read 15.
